lines: In such in such in place having worshipped rite should perform; as another disciple's practice not by another disciple is known.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tādṛśe tādṛśe dhāmni pūjayitvā vidhiṃ caret yathānyaśiṣyānuṣṭhānaṃ nānyaśiṣyeṇa budhyate
